description: Use when: estimate_total says the parcel is over the weight limit, or the user asks how to ship many sets most cheaply. Do NOT use: for a single set in one parcel (estimate_total is enough), or to send a request (use request_quote). Returns: the given sets split into the parcels with the lowest estimated delivered total (USD, duties and shipping included) to US, CA or JP: each parcel pays one shipping charge for its weight and one customs fee, and a parcel has a weight limit. Each parcel, the total and the saving against one parcel per set. An estimate, not a confirmed price. Example requests: "I want five Korean sets sent to LA. What is the cheapest way to ship them?" / "한국 세트 여러 개를 미국으로 보낼 때 몇 상자로 나누는 게 제일 싸?" / "韓国のセットを何個かまとめて日本に送るなら、一番安い分け方は？"

ship_region.description: Optional state, province or prefecture (Canada tax differs by province).
